recording.micToggleDisabledTip: Microphone cannot be toggled during recording
recording.standardModeDescription: Capture the screen and audio without mouse or click telemetry; the pointer remains visible in the video. Save a high-quality MP4 locally without opening the editor. Webcam overlays are unavailable in this mode.
recording.editorModeDescription: Open the editor after recording to adjust cursor, zoom, webcam, and other effects.
recording.webcamUnavailableInStandardMode: Webcam overlays are unavailable in standard recording
recording.savingStandardSubtitle: Saving video to your recordings folder

update.errorTitle: Update check failed. Click to retry.

sourceSelector.windowsNote: Only visible (non-minimized) windows can be recorded.

permissions.screenRecordingNeeded: Recordio needs Screen Recording permission before you start. System Settings has been opened. After enabling it, quit and reopen Recordio.
permissions.screenRecordingMissing: Screen Recording permission is still missing. System Settings has been opened again. Enable it, then quit and reopen Recordio before recording.
permissions.accessibilityNeeded: Recordio also needs Accessibility permission for cursor tracking. System Settings has been opened. After enabling it, quit and reopen Recordio.
permissions.accessibilityMissing: Accessibility permission is still missing. System Settings has been opened again. Enable it, then quit and reopen Recordio before recording.
permissions.selectSource: Please select a source to record
permissions.systemAudioUnavailable: System audio is not available for this source. Recording will continue without system audio.
permissions.microphoneDenied: Microphone access was denied. Recording will continue without microphone audio.

updateToast.experimentalDescription: You've opted into experimental updates so you have the choice to test the latest update of Recordio before it's widely available.
updateToast.availableDescription: Recordio {{version}} has an update ready to download.
updateToast.downloadingDescription: Downloading the update. You can track the progress below.
updateToast.readyDescription: The update is downloaded and ready to install.
updateToast.downloadFailedDescription: The download failed. Open Settings > About and use Cloud download to download it manually.
